metadata.title: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah Altmann [10. April 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.115

## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah Altmann [10. April 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.115
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.115
- Datum: 10.4.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
10. April 1941 Dear Hannah, now your little lamb is with us for the
easter-holiday week and we will do all to make her the time as pleasant
as possible. She has grown up and looks again like a ballet-dancer in her
short frock and this shall be arranged in the next days. It seems that she
likes her new home and we like her very much and we have the impression
that the surroundings and the way of living is absolutely what we wanted
for her; under our supervision she will write today a long letter for you
and I can imagine how eagerly you will read it. Please dont be worried
that she is away, I understand your feelings but dont forget that very
big ordeals are still ahead of us before the victory and that the feeling
to know her safe should be for you in the hours of longing a comfort.
So be relieved that she is either treated harshly nor spoiled, we hope
that we have just found the right thing for her.
I thank you so much for all the trouble you have for us. There
should before the taxation day some royalties from Cassels (perhaps
you can write him/and Paul Tabori (you will fix his adress/number
as we nearly a year ago just before I left the remittance of Hunga
rian royalties, which should be paid by an English publisher. Perhaps
you find still his letter or write him if it was not paid in July
or August; it may be that he has used my absence for not paying
but you can write to him that on behalf of tax purposes you have
to ask him about.
As to the power of attorney I will speak to the Vice-Consul of
the British Consulate whom I shall see Saturday in our house; he
is a charming man with great literary interest and we like him
personally very much.
I have started to work again and all goes his quiet way; would
it not be, that we always have to take new decisions we would not
complain. But also we do not know if and when we go to Brazil,
there are pros and contras and nobody knows what is right and
best in such an absurd time. Anyway, I continue to work and avoid
seeing people as much as possible. Lotte feels much better since
the injection-treatment and health is the most important as
but have which demand strength of nerves from us all. Yours Stefan Zweig
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief von Stefan Zweig. Der Text am linken Rand ist vertikal geschrieben und lautet: 'the injection-treatment and health is the most important as but have which demand strength of nerves from us all. Yours Stefan Zweig'. Dieser Text ist in der Transkription am Ende des Haupttextes integriert.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Die Seite zeigt Ausschnitte des Briefes, die bereits auf Seite 1 transkribiert wurden.
